title: Replace ordinary plugin wheel catalog entries with compiled artifacts
summary: Make the optional remote plugin catalog describe downloadable compiled-plugin.json artifacts and verify those artifacts before installation; remove all wheelUrl terminology and wheel materialization from ordinary plugin lifecycle.
forbiddenResponsibilities: wheelUrl or wheel_url ordinary plugin catalog fields
ordinary plugin wheel download or materialization
catalog conformance based on Python package metadata
compatibility fallback from compiled artifact to wheel
acceptance: catalog entries require artifactUrl and identify compiled-plugin.json artifacts
remote artifact bytes are digest checked and validated as CompiledPluginContract before installation
ordinary lifecycle no longer imports or emits wheel terminology
local source install and installed-contract lifecycle remain functional
provider wheel release code is unchanged

humanApproval.decision: Approved by the requirement that ordinary plugins are data-only and compatibility is not retained.
